about.heroDescription: AIVO was founded by parents and educators who believe that neurodiversity is a strength, not a limitation. We're building the future of personalized education—one learner at a time.
founderParagraphs: AIVO began with a simple observation: traditional education systems often fail neurodiverse learners. Not because these students can't learn, but because the system wasn't designed for how they think.

As parents of neurodiverse children and special education professionals, our founding team experienced these challenges firsthand. We watched brilliant children struggle with one-size-fits-all curricula, lose confidence, and fall behind their peers.

We knew there had to be a better way. Combining expertise in AI, education, and child development, we set out to create something revolutionary: a learning platform that adapts to each child's unique mind, not the other way around.
Today, AIVO serves over 150 families, and we're just getting started.
about.founderQuote: "Every child deserves to learn in a way that makes sense to them."

privacy.metaDescription: AIVO Learning Privacy Policy - Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information. FERPA and COPPA compliant.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy

introduction.p1: AIVO Learning, Inc. ("AIVO," "we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting the privacy of all users of our educational platform, including students, parents, guardians, and educators.
introduction.p2: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our website, mobile applications, and services (collectively, the "Platform").
introduction.callout: AIVO is fully compliant with FERPA and COPPA regulations.

accountInformation.intro: When you create an account, we collect:
items: Name and email address
Role (parent, student, teacher, administrator)
Password (stored securely using encryption)
Profile information you choose to provide

learningData.intro: To provide personalized learning experiences, we collect:
items: Learning activities and progress
Assessment results and performance data
Interactions with AI tutoring features
Learning preferences and accommodations
IEP goals (when provided by parents or educators)

technicalData.intro: We automatically collect certain technical information:
items: Device type, operating system, and browser
IP address and general location
Usage patterns and session duration
Error logs for troubleshooting

childrensPrivacy.p1: AIVO takes children's privacy very seriously. We comply fully with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA).

parentalConsent.p1: For users under 13 years of age, we require verifiable parental consent before collecting personal information. Parents or guardians must create and manage accounts for children under 13.

informationFromChildren.p1: We collect only the minimum information necessary to provide our educational services to children. This includes:
items: First name (or nickname)
Learning activities and progress
Preferences for accessibility and accommodations

parentalRights.intro: Parents and guardians have the right to:
items: Review their child's personal information
Request deletion of their child's data
Refuse further collection of their child's information
Withdraw consent at any time

howWeUse.intro: We use the information we collect to:
items: Provide personalized learning experiences
Track educational progress and generate reports
Improve our AI algorithms and content
Communicate important updates and information
Ensure platform security and prevent abuse
Comply with legal obligations
Provide customer support
doNotItems: Sell your personal information to third parties
Use student data for advertising purposes
Share data with advertisers or data brokers

dataSecurity.intro: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information:

items.label: Encryption:
items.text: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256)

items.label: Access Controls:
items.text: Strict role-based access controls limit who can access data

items.label: Regular Audits:
items.text: We conduct regular security audits and penetration testing

items.label: Employee Training:
items.text: All employees receive privacy and security training

items.label: Incident Response:
items.text: We have procedures to detect and respond to data breaches

ferpaCompliance.p1: For educational institutions using AIVO, we comply with the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA).
items: We act as a "school official" with legitimate educational interest
We use student data only for authorized educational purposes
We maintain appropriate security for education records
We do not disclose student information without proper authorization
ferpaCompliance.p2: Schools using AIVO can enter into agreements that ensure FERPA compliance. Contact us at privacy@aivolearning.com for more information.

items.label: Access:
items.text: Request a copy of your personal data

items.label: Deletion:
items.text: Request deletion of your data (subject to legal requirements)

items.label: Export:
items.text: Request your data in a portable format

yourRights.p2: To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@aivolearning.com.

dataRetention.intro: We retain your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide our services. Specifically:

items.label: Active accounts:
items.text: Data is retained while the account is active

items.label: Inactive accounts:
items.text: Data is retained for 2 years after last activity

items.label: Deleted accounts:
items.text: Data is permanently deleted within 30 days of deletion request

items.label: Legal holds:
items.text: Some data may be retained longer if required by law

thirdPartyServices.intro: We use trusted third-party services to operate our Platform. These include:

items.label: Analytics:
items.text: To understand how our Platform is used (anonymized)

thirdPartyServices.p2: All third-party providers are contractually bound to protect your data and use it only for the purposes we specify.

changesToPolicy.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by:
items: Posting the new policy on this page

whatAreCookies.heading: What Are Cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and provide information to the website owners.
We also use similar technologies like local storage and session storage, which work similarly to cookies. When we refer to "cookies" in this policy, we include these similar technologies.

faq.metaDescription: Find answers to common questions about AIVO Learning, our AI tutoring platform for neurodiverse students, pricing, features, and implementation.
faq.ogDescription: Common questions about AI personalized learning for neurodiverse students
faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about AIVO Learning, our AI tutoring platform, and how we support neurodiverse learners.

items.question: What is AIVO Learning?
items.answer: AIVO Learning is an AI-powered personalized learning platform specifically designed for neurodiverse K-12 students. We use Virtual Brain AI tutors that adapt to each student's unique learning style, pace, and needs. Our platform supports students with ADHD, autism, dyslexia, dyscalculia, and other learning differences.

items.question: What is a Virtual Brain?
items.answer: A Virtual Brain is AIVO's personalized AI tutor that adapts to how each student learns best. It tracks learning patterns, preferences, strengths, and challenges to create a customized learning experience. Think of it as a dedicated tutor who understands exactly how your child thinks and learns.

items.question: Is AIVO only for neurodiverse students?
items.answer: While AIVO is designed with neurodiverse learners in mind, our adaptive technology benefits all students. Every learner is unique, and AIVO personalizes education for each individual regardless of whether they have a diagnosed learning difference.

items.question: What learning differences does AIVO support?
items.answer: AIVO provides specialized support for ADHD, autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyscalculia, dysgraphia, executive function challenges, and other learning differences. Each condition has dedicated features like focus mode for ADHD, visual schedules for autism, text-to-speech for dyslexia, and visual math for dyscalculia.

items.question: Can AIVO help with IEP goals?
items.answer: Yes! AIVO includes real-time IEP goal tracking and progress monitoring. Teachers can align lessons with IEP objectives, track student progress toward goals, and generate detailed reports for IEP meetings. The platform automatically collects data points that demonstrate progress on specific goals.

items.question: What subjects does AIVO teach?
items.answer: AIVO covers all core K-12 subjects including Math, Reading/ELA, Writing, Science, and Social Studies. We also offer SEL (Social-Emotional Learning), executive function training, and life skills modules. All content is standards-aligned and adapts to each student's grade level and abilities.

items.question: Does AIVO work 24/7?
items.answer: Yes! AIVO's AI tutors are available 24/7 for homework help, practice, and learning support. Students can learn at their own pace, any time of day. Human support from our team is available 8am-8pm ET for technical issues and implementation questions.

items.question: Is AIVO accessible?
items.answer: Absolutely. AIVO is built to WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards. We include text-to-speech, speech-to-text, adjustable fonts and colors, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, captions, high contrast modes, and more. Accessibility is core to our design.

items.question: Is my child's data safe?
items.answer: Yes. AIVO is FERPA and COPPA compliant. We use end-to-end encryption, never sell student data, never show ads, and follow strict data protection protocols. We're committed to the Student Privacy Pledge and are pursuing SOC 2 Type II certification.

items.question: Who can see my child's learning data?
items.answer: Only you (the parent/guardian), your child's assigned teachers, and necessary school administrators can access your child's learning data. Data is never shared with third parties. Parents have full control and can request data deletion at any time.

items.question: Do you sell student data or show ads?
items.answer: No, never. AIVO does not sell, rent, or share student data with any third parties. We do not show advertisements. Our revenue comes exclusively from subscriptions, not from monetizing user data.

items.question: How much does AIVO cost?
items.answer: AIVO offers several plans: Free (limited features), Family ($29/month for up to 3 students), Classroom ($15/student/month), and custom School/District pricing. All paid plans include a 30-day free trial with no credit card required.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: Yes! All paid plans include a 30-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card is required to start your trial. You can cancel anytime during the trial with no charges.

items.question: Can I get funding or grants for AIVO?
items.answer: Yes, many schools use IDEA funds, Title I funds, ESSER funds, or special education budgets to cover AIVO. We provide documentation and support for grant applications. Contact our sales team for assistance with funding options.

items.question: Do you offer discounts for multiple students?
items.answer: Yes. Our Family plan covers up to 3 students at $29/month (significant savings vs individual). Schools and districts receive volume discounts. Non-profits and Title I schools may qualify for additional discounts.

items.question: How long does implementation take?
items.answer: For individual families: 15 minutes. For classrooms: 1-2 days for roster setup and training. For schools/districts: 2-4 weeks including rostering, training, and professional development. We provide full implementation support.

items.question: Does AIVO integrate with Google Classroom?
items.answer: Yes! AIVO integrates seamlessly with Google Classroom for automatic roster sync, assignment posting, and grade passback. We also integrate with Canvas, Schoology, Clever, and ClassLink.

items.question: What devices work with AIVO?
items.answer: AIVO works on any modern device: Chromebooks, iPads, tablets, Windows/Mac computers, and smartphones. We have web apps (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge) and mobile apps for iOS and Android. We also offer the AIVO Pad, our purpose-built learning tablet.

items.question: Do I need special equipment?
items.answer: No special equipment needed! AIVO works with standard devices and internet connection. Optional: headphones for audio content, stylus for writing activities, webcam for certain interactive features.

items.question: How does AIVO help teachers save time?
items.answer: AIVO automates differentiation, progress monitoring, and data collection. Teachers report saving 5-10 hours per week on lesson planning and assessment. The platform handles individualization while teachers focus on high-impact instruction and relationships.

items.question: Can teachers create custom content?
items.answer: Yes! Teachers can create custom lessons, assignments, and assessments. You can also curate content from AIVO's library, import your existing materials, or use AI assistance to generate adapted content.

items.question: What training do teachers receive?
items.answer: We provide comprehensive training including video tutorials, interactive onboarding, live webinars, and ongoing professional development. Most teachers are comfortable using AIVO within 1-2 weeks. Certification courses are also available.

items.question: What results do students see with AIVO?
items.answer: Students using AIVO average 1.5 years of learning growth in one school year. 87% of students are engaged daily, and 94% of parents report their child is more confident and independent in learning. Results vary by individual.

items.question: Is AIVO research-based?
items.answer: Yes. AIVO is built on evidence-based practices including Universal Design for Learning (UDL), differentiated instruction, multi-sensory instruction, spaced repetition, and cognitive load theory. We partner with research institutions to continuously validate our approach.

items.question: How quickly will I see progress?
items.answer: Most families notice increased engagement within the first week. Measurable academic progress typically shows within 4-6 weeks of consistent use (3-4 times per week). Long-term gains compound over months of use.
